subject: Reschedule: Demo with Redwood Inference - re: re:Invent blackout
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro/demo request — Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the intro from our procurement team — we'd love to see Redwood Inference in action. We're evaluating inference platforms this quarter and want to include a short technical demo for our infra and security teams.

Would you have 45 minutes the week of Nov 24 or the week of Nov 30? Our preference is Nov 27 afternoon PT.

Attendees (tentative): Priya Sharma (Secops), Miguel Alvarez (Infra), Sam Lee (SRE).

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Director, Security Engineering
Acme Corp
priya@acme.com
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — Redwood Inference

Hi Priya — great to hear from you and thanks for the context. Nov 27 at 1:00pm PT works on our side; I'll share a calendar invite and a short agenda (architecture + integration + Q&A).

Proposed agenda:
- 10 min: intros & priorities
- 20 min: demo (serving runtime, latency/cost controls)
- 10 min: integration/security checklist
- 5 min: next steps / mutual action plan

Attachment: Demo-invite-20251127.ics

Looking forward to it — will add Marissa (solutions) to the thread for technical prep.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 14:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro/demo request — Redwood Inference (heads-up: re:Invent)

Marissa, Stephanie — quick heads-up: we confirmed a demo with Acme for Nov 27 (1pm PT). Unfortunately that's squarely in our re:Invent blackout (team on booth/support/travel Nov 25-29). Can one of you cover the session or should I ask to reschedule?

Options I see:
- Move to Tues Dec 2 / Wed Dec 3 (same 1pm PT) — preferred from my calendar
- Keep Nov 27 and have Marissa run the demo (Marissa, you OK with that?)

If we reschedule I'll send a polite note to Priya with a couple of options and updated invite. Also attaching our pricing one-pager to share if they ask.

Attachment: Redwood-pricing-flyer.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 08:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — Redwood Inference / scheduling update

Hi Priya — quick update and apologies for the short notice. We're participating heavily at AWS re:Invent Nov 25–29 and a few members of our demo team (including me) will be on the booth or in sessions that week. We don't want to deliver a subpar experience.

Would you be open to moving our demo to one of these windows?
- Tue, Dec 2 at 10:00am PT
- Tue, Dec 2 at 1:00pm PT
- Wed, Dec 3 at 10:00am PT

If any of those work I'll send an updated invite. Otherwise we can keep Nov 27 and Marissa can run the session; she'll be excellent, but I wanted to offer the option so I can be on the call personally if you'd like.

Attachments: Demo-invite-20251202.ics (proposed)

Thanks again for the flexibility — let me know what works and we'll lock it in.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
From: Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — Redwood Inference / scheduling update

Hi Jonas — thanks for the heads-up and totally understand re: re:Invent. Let's move to Tue, Dec 2 at 10:00am PT. That time works for our infra and security folks.

Please send the updated invite and I'll forward to our SREs. Looking forward to the demo.

Thanks,
Priya
